text: huh. i did that, rebuilt/relaunched and same thing
resolution: Fixed the remaining gray compiled-wall case by preserving the material-under-paint relationship. Paint materialization now stores the underlay texture id, the compiler emits the underlay material row plus the transparent cutout-stencil overlay row for painted faces, and the native transparent 3D pass accepts coplanar overlays with less_equal depth. This matches the editor/test preview where the brush strokes sit over the brick instead of replacing the whole face with a transparent shader fallback.
